mapper.select: SELECT vac.id, vac.mec_id, vac.campus_id, vac.student_id, stu.student_name, vac.start_time, vac.off_time, vac.apply_time, vac.dispose_time, vac.type FROM bd_ask_leave vac LEFT JOIN bd_student stu ON vac.student_id = stu.id WHERE vac.type = #{type} AND ((#{endInWeek} BETWEEN vac.start_time AND off_time) OR (#{startInWeek} < vac.start_time AND #{endInWeek} > off_time) OR (#{startInWeek} BETWEEN vac.start_time AND off_time) ) AND vac.is_delete = 0 AND vac.mec_id = #{mecId} AND vac.campus_id = #{campusId}

SELECT vac.id, vac.mec_id, vac.campus_id, vac.student_id, stu.student_name, vac.start_time, vac.off_time, vac.apply_time, vac.dispose_time, vac.type, vac.id, vac.leave_reason, vac.refuse_reason FROM bd_ask_leave vac LEFT JOIN bd_student stu ON vac.student_id = stu.id WHERE vac.is_delete = 0 and vac.id = #{id}
